distractors.reason: 'Deeply' goes with feelings and emotions: deeply worried, deeply moved. We don't say 'deeply refundable'.
'Highly' goes with quality or likelihood: highly recommended, highly likely. It doesn't describe refund rules.
'Very' is too general here. Native speakers use 'fully' to say that the whole amount can be refunded.

example_sentence: The ticket is ___ refundable if you cancel early.
l1_interference: Türkçe'de 'tamamen' ve 'tam' kelimeleri birçok durumda birbirinin yerine kullanılır. Ancak İngilizce'de 'refundable' ile en doğal kombinasyon 'fully'dir. Türkçe konuşanlar bazen 'very refundable' ya da 'highly refundable' diyebilir; bu ifadeler doğal değildir.
explanation: In English, some adverbs combine only with certain adjectives. 'Fully' is the natural choice when something is completely returned or paid back. Learn the whole phrase rather than choosing the adverb by its general meaning.

related_collocations.example: Delivery is completely free for orders over fifty dollars.
This shop is highly recommended for cheap shoes.
The hotel is fully booked this weekend.

memory_tip: FULLY REFUNDABLE = all of the money comes back | DEEPLY = feelings, HIGHLY = quality or likelihood, FULLY = complete
